judge.voice: The level, B1, is right, and I was glad that it did not talk to me as a Czech learner. It caught my "responsible about" slip, which is real. But I told it twice that my Friday interview is the point, and the tasks were still about a carrier's dropped calls. Nobody asked me "tell me about a problem you solved". The last two questions were almost the same. The summary says "your job interview" in a template way. For seven minutes it is fine, and I trust the level. But I would want interview questions before I come back tomorrow. I would tell a friend it finds your level, not that it prepares you for an interview yet.
